hero.subtitle: Websites, billing and accounts software, custom ERPs and full apps for growing businesses. Built faster with AI, held to the standards of 12+ years in professional IT.

contact.location: Tamil Nadu, India · working with clients India-wide

journey.title: Where it started
journey.text: Built service-tracking software for a local mobile shop. My first paying client.

journey.title: They came back
journey.text: The same shop asked for accounts software to track money in, money out and vendor payments.

journey.title: First referral
journey.text: Their business partner needed invoice management for a textile brand. That became Eclipse.

journey.title: Same idea, new business
journey.text: Adapted the invoice system for Polymer Plastics, a manufacturer with different billing rules.

journey.title: Bigger systems, first websites
journey.text: A larger multi-branch suite for the mobile shop, then websites for RVS Holidays and NSL.

journey.title: Mainext Innovations
journey.text: Gave the work a name and took on a full custom ERP.

journey.title: AI-first
journey.text: Every build now runs on an AI-assisted workflow. Building my own app, Gromet, alongside client work.
